dogecoin.text: Dogecoin developers are planning a hackathon focused on creating a mega API to support future IRS data initiatives. The hackathon aims to foster tools that simplify access and reporting across multiple systems while remaining fully open-source.

Musks Dogecoin Foundation is reportedly using AI tools to monitor activity and communications of U.S. federal workers. The initiative has sparked privacy concerns among watchdogs, though no official response has been issued by federal agencies yet.
